'''Scorpia''' is a large female [[scorpion]] [[boss]] that resides in a cave beneath the [[Scorpion Pit]] located in Wilderness level 53-55.

Scorpia is notable for dropping one of the three shards that form the [[malediction ward]] and [[odium ward]], with the [[Crazy archaeologist]] and [[Chaos Fanatic]] dropping the other pieces. Killing all three at least once is a hard [[Wilderness Diary]] task.

==Fight overview==
{{Main|Scorpia/Strategies}}
The [[Scorpion Pit]] and the surrounding area is a [[multi-combat area]] in level 50+ [[Wilderness]], so player killers '''may attack you''' at any time while fighting the boss.

The pit is filled with many [[Scorpia's offspring (monster)|Scorpia's offspring]], which use weak but accurate ranged attacks. Scorpia herself uses melee attacks which, whether successful or not, drain the player's prayer points by 2 if they have the [[Protect from Melee]] prayer active. Both Scorpia and her offspring are capable of inflicting [[poison]], starting at 20 and 6 damage, respectively.

Once Scorpia falls below 50% health, the next attack against her, whether successful or not, will cause her to summon two [[Scorpia's guardian]]s. These guardians will rapidly heal her when within 3 tiles of her.

Scorpia is weak to [[Magic]] attacks due to her low [[Magic]] offensive stats. An effective strategy is to fight her at range by [[freezing]] her, either killing the guardians once they spawn, or freezing them while luring Scorpia out of their healing range.
